milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the potted poppy (within 5 blocks) and face toward it (within 60° tolerance) to demonstrate they have visually located it. The potted poppy is at spawn-relative (8, 1, 7) inside an oak plank shelter with a 3-wide open north entrance. A max_distance of 5 ensures the player has approached the structure (not just passed nearby), and facing_tolerance of 60° confirms the player is actually looking toward the potted poppy rather than facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because the task is about finding/observing an object, not merely reaching a location.
